title: Learning Where Outcomes Change:Credit-Addressable Reasoning for Multimodal Geometry
abstract: arXiv:2608.30457v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Multimodal geometry reasoning requires VLMs to extract precise visual relations and preserve them through multi-step deduction. Existing free-form traces obscure the decisions that determine the answer, and trajectory-level reinforcement learning distributes a single terminal signal across the entire response. We introduce credit-addressable reasoning, in which the semantic units exposed during inference also define where learning compares alternatives and assigns credit. We instantiate this principle with Code-CoT, which retains the diagram, represents visual relations as line-addressable executable code, and organizes reasoning into typed events, and CE-GRPO, which selects event boundaries using structural priors and type-normalized entropy, samples complete continuations from shared prefixes, and converts outcome differences into localized advantages. translated_title: 学习结果变化之处：面向多模态几何的信用可寻址推理
translated_abstract: 多模态几何推理要求视觉语言模型（VLM）提取精确的视觉关系，并在多步演绎过程中保持这些关系。现有的自由形式推理轨迹掩盖了决定答案的关键决策，而轨迹级强化学习则将单一的终端信号分散到整个响应中。我们提出信用可寻址推理，即推理时暴露的语义单元同时定义了学习在何处比较备选方案并分配信用。我们通过 Code-CoT 实例化这一原则——它保留图形，将视觉关系表示为可按行寻址的可执行代码，并将推理组织为类型化事件；同时通过 CE-GRPO 实现这一原则——它利用结构先验和类型归一化熵来选择事件边界，从共享前缀中采样完整的延续，并将结果差异转化为局部化优势。在九个几何基准测试中，CE-GRPO 实现了平均 76.04 的准确率，优于现有方法。
tldr: 该论文提出“信用可寻址推理”框架，通过 Code-CoT 将视觉关系编码为可按行寻址的可执行代码并以类型化事件组织推理，结合 CE-GRPO 将结果差异转化为局部化优势信号，在九个几何基准上取得 76.04 的平均准确率。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces credit-addressable reasoning, instantiated as Code-CoT (representing visual relations as line-addressable executable code organized into typed events) and CE-GRPO (converting outcome differences into localized advantages), achieving 76.04 average accuracy across nine geometry benchmarks.
